objective: I run a small bakery and my staff keep losing track of custom cake orders. I want a simple internal web page where they can log an order with the pickup date, see what is due in the next few days, and mark orders as paid and picked up. Nothing public, no card payments, and it has to run on the shop laptop without installing anything.
